pick.headline: Sarin gas attack on the Tokyo subway
pick.summary: On 20 March 1995 members of the Aum Shinrikyo cult released sarin nerve gas on the Tokyo subway during the morning rush hour, killing 13 and injuring thousands.
pick.significance: It was the deadliest chemical terrorism by a non-state group. Aum had a large presence in Russia, which came under scrutiny.
